projects.name: Iowa DOT Five Year Program Projects (public view)
projects.notes: 2027-2031 Iowa Transportation Improvement Program (Program = '2027-2031 Program'); all records are programmed future work, one row per project/year/work type (Year2 = 2027..2031; SummaryWorkType and SummaryYears roll up the project). 'Right of Way' is its own Work_Type. AmountTotal looks like thousands of dollars (sample 2306) - check before use. No status field. Table 1 in the same service is the report table.
